title: Matt Miller's serious car accident has sparked scrutiny over his business dealings

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt Miller's serious car accident has sparked scrutiny over his business dealings
sources.description: Last week's shocking news that ESPN draft analyst Matt Miller was involved in a serious car accident that resulted in the amputation of his left arm, along with other significant injuries, prompted an outpouring of support for him — both with words and, after his family created a GoFundMe effort, money.
